name: Jennea's Flask

description: At the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind, Jennea Cannon sends apprentices to Mirror Lake for water. They bring the sample back for arcane analysis.
intro: At the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind, Jennea Cannon sends apprentices to Mirror Lake for water. They bring the sample back for arcane analysis.

p: After magical struggles across Azeroth, arcane currents have torn loose from their ancient channels. Jennea Cannon seeks to learn how these shifts have affected Elwynn Forest. She gives promising apprentices a glass flask and sends them southwest of Stormwind's gates to the base of Mirror Lake's waterfall. The flask protects the water sample on the journey back to the Wizard's Sanctum, where it can be examined for arcane disturbances.

Jennea's flask lets Stormwind's mages check whether shifting ley lines have tainted Mirror Lake. If the water carries harmful magic, the surrounding life and anyone who drinks from it could suffer strange afflictions. A sample can reveal magical residue before tainted currents spread through the countryside.
